title: The Abbey Mash
logline: When an orbital monastery's holy tuber harvest fails, the cellarer secretly cuts the sacred liqueur with industrial spirits while the abbot proclaims a miracle.

roles.description: The abbey's practical brewmaster; panicked, pragmatically cynical, and desperate to conceal an empty cellar.
A serene monastic superior who mistakes a fraudulent fermentation pipeline for divine intervention.
A peaceful cloisters station adrift in the asteroid shadow, famous for its hundred-proof tuber spirit.
A disreputable dive bar docked at the lower mining ring where black-market liquor changes hands.

public_situation: The sacred orbital abbey in {system} claims its antique still is producing twice its normal output of blessed tuber liqueur despite severe blight.
private_truth: The cellarer accidentally killed the mother yeast with bleach and has been buying cheap industrial engine alcohol to blend into the communion barrels.

beats.public_change: The abbey announces a doubled distribution of commemorative blessed bottles to local station chapels.

missions.reason: The monk needs an outsider to discreetly fetch thirty drums of unlabeled grain alcohol from a saloon backroom before evening vespers begin.
missions.private_fact: The monk is paying for the bootleg solvent with coins taken directly from the monastery's sanctuary restoration fund.

beats.public_change: Miners who drink the new batch begin suffering severe optical dizziness, prompting station dockers to question the brew.

missions.reason: The cellarer asks the pilot to scan the distillery's condenser pipes and isolate the contaminated tanks before the prior leads pilgrims inside.
missions.private_fact: The prior has locked the main cellar gates with prayer ribbons, believing any inspection would show lack of faith in the miraculous vat.

beats.public_change: The prior orders the remaining sixty casks loaded for public sale, while hospital clinics treat poisoned dockers.

missions.reason: The monk begs the pilot to courier an urgent chemical neutralizing reagent to the bottling line before the communion casks ship out.
missions.private_fact: The neutralizing reagent will render the booze completely tasteless, ruining the abbey's legendary recipe forever.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the bottling vats with the neutralizing agent. The prior proclaims the sweet taste is holy proof, while the terrified cellarer begs to dump the batch.

options.label: Trigger the emergency drainage vents and dump the entire poisonous batch into space
Administer the reagent to save lives, reducing the sacred spirit to flat mineral water
Divert the uncut barrels to the smugglers' saloon for quick cash before anyone notices

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot vents the toxic spirit into open space.
resolutions.summary: The contaminated mash freezes in glittering clouds across {system}; {role:abbey_prior} laments a lost miracle while {role:cellar_monk} silently weeps in relief.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew the valves on a monastic distillery and showered the trade lane in hundred-proof holy rot.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot neutralizes the mash into tasteless water.
resolutions.summary: The liqueur cures but loses all flavour; pilgrims conclude the blessing has departed and {role:abbey_distillery} turns to selling ordinary filtered water.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot diverts the toxic barrels to the black-market saloon.
resolutions.summary: {role:cellar_monk} pockets a small fortune from miners seeking cheap thrills, while {role:abbey_prior} wonders why the sanctuary fund is suddenly overflowing.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a corrupt monk fence adulterated holy booze to miners on the rim.

resolutions.reached_by: The batch ships uncut or the delivery is abandoned.
resolutions.summary: Dozens of pilgrims suffer severe methanol poisoning, station constables seal {role:abbey_distillery}, and {role:cellar_monk} is locked in the brig.

loose_threads.detail: The saloon's solvent barrels were labeled as ecclesiastical candle oil with forged bishopric seals.
The monastery ledger records a sudden deficit in chapel renovation funds matching the distillery's solvent purchases.

radio_hooks: Pilgrims flock to {system} shrine as abbey claims miraculous bumper yield of tuber brandy.
Clinic doctors in {system} issue warning regarding counterfeit monastery spirits.
Dockers in {system} joke that the latest batch of holy liqueur can strip hull varnish.

voice_direction.cellar_monk: Nervous, breathless, stammering between piety and sheer criminal terror. Constantly recites frantic prayers while doing shady deals.
voice_direction.abbey_prior: Pompous, beatific, speaking in flowery cadence with unwavering conviction that everything is a miraculous sign.
